adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `EmbedController#best` which enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` whenever `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil, with no controller-side throttling (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The only gate is `ensure_embeddable`, which trusts `request.referer`/Origin host matching `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (spoofable by a client). In the job path, `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` throttles on a Redis key that is the full `@embed_url` string (`retrieved:#{@embed_url}`), so varying query strings (`?x=N`) yields unique keys and bypasses the 60s throttle (lib/topic_retriever.rb). `TopicEmbed.import`/`import_remote` then creates a new topic/embed per unique URL (unique index is on `embed_url`), so an attacker can flood jobs and cause unbounded HTTP fetches and topic creation for that host.
